venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Partly cloudy, highs around 70, dropping to 50 overnight
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 11/19 (MOD MKZ // JK; entered by JK; posted 12:15am ET 11/20)** Net $1,439 vs target $1,869 (77.0%). Food $313; no events; comps $26.95 (1.9%; industry love $6.90, friends & family $5.55, O4W $14.50). 40 guests; check avg $35.97. A bit quiet at open; weather has been brisk in the late afternoon, with some nights already dipping into the 30s this season and colder temps projected to return in about two weeks. Guest flow picked up around 5pm and stayed steady until about 8:30pm, with several groups in for a round after work. Cleared out around 9pm as the opening bartender was cut; a lull, then a small pop around 10pm for a quick drink that didn't last — very quiet by 10:45pm. 16 Meal Deals and 4 Football Combos sold; not a great game, so few guests paid attention to the projector. Front door stayed open until about 9pm, closed as the temperature dropped. Chill end to the night, smooth last call, a small group of ladies arrived right at last call; everyone out right at 12am. Kitchen: lots of Meal Deals to start the night; good job ABK'ing the BOH space. No events; no maintenance needs. 86 Shorty Service; ponies are in house but the team should go through all 12oz High Life cans before moving back to glass bottles. No-shows not charged. Highlight: seeing two neighborhood regulars who have been coming since the beginning.

venues.name: CC Nashville

Event sales $8,295; food $14; comps $4.70 (0.05%; industry). Guests ~12 (more with the event) and check avg $34.37 — the form notes neither is accurate with the event. The bar did $412 before the event. Kitchen: early night for JMS. 86 CVDT, Lalo; low tonic, aquavit. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: rocking the event with the crew — everything went as smooth as can be, and great to see the sales.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 11/19 (AM MOD Maggie S; PM MOD Graham; entered by Graham; posted 2:37am ET 11/20)** Net $9,866.20 incl. events; no daily target reported on the form. AM (coffee) $714.13, D&C PM $9,152.07, Garden/6A n/a; no event sales reported. Food incl. events $2,227.10. Comps $351.15 (3.6%). 255 guests (Tock); check avg $38.69 (net incl. events / guests). AM notes: none ('MIA'). PM: a fairly busy Thursday night — started with a pop around 5:30pm and kept cooking all the way through close; one server was off the floor around 9pm and the remaining two did a great job taking care of the floor. Kitchen: steady night; the line washed its own dish pit because no one was on duty in the dishwashing area, and front-of-house staff helped out. Break make-up complete. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Highlight: two friends of the team strolling in at 11:15pm to say hi and cheer on a team member hitting the one-year mark.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 11/19 (MOD Jane, Chef Steve; entered by Stef; posted 1:59am ET 11/20)** Net $3,906 vs target $5,990 (65.2%). Food $311, beverage $3,595; no event sales reported; comps $75 (1.9%). 127 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $30.76 (net/guests; form $31). A very mellow night with a half-full room for most of the evening. Many one-and-dones and plenty of date nights, but the energy stayed smooth through the slower periods. Lots of out-of-towners bringing their groups in on a recommendation, and many back-catalogue asks — perhaps the slower energy made guests more open to conversation. Top sellers: Crossover Episode, Rosalie and Native Lion (tied), King Mambo. Kitchen: no notes. Door: a very chill night with only 10 reservations to start; a bit chilly but nothing crazy; no waitlist, mostly 2s with the occasional 3; overall very slow for a Thursday. Several non-customer visits at the door (resume drop-offs, neighbors' package returns). No no-shows; no-shows not charged. Menu count 20/20. Breakage: 1 tulip. Maintenance: the immersion blender is broken.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 11/19 (MOD Gigi, Chef Jersh; entered by Gigi; posted 4:33am ET 11/20)** Net $7,592 vs target $5,787 (131.2%). Marquee $7,592 (food $1,251); Standing Room $0; total food $1,251. Comps $39.90 (0.5%; 3 DNLs, a member, a shareholder). 166 guests; check avg $106.93 as reported on the form (net/guests works out to $45.73 — the form figure doesn't reconcile). Started super hot: a 10-top reservation plus 5 other reservations right at 6pm, and the entire space filled in the first 30 minutes — almost $2k in the first hour, with a manager stepping behind the bar to help bang out drinks. Slowed a bit afterward but stayed very consistent; never really formed a waitlist — the perfect pace to constantly turn tables. Lots of large parties, accommodated creatively by the host (a 4-top at table 21 and many 5-tops around the room). A contact from Crypto Arena stopped by to scope out Standing Room for a December event and was put in touch with the events lead. Great hustle from everyone; floor cut around midnight and a very smooth close. Ready for a very busy week ahead. Kitchen: huge rush at the beginning; ticket times crushed, nothing over 20 minutes; the large groups ordered a lot of food, Kumiai oysters a standout. Event notes: an event tab from 11/18 was rung in; notes left for the events lead in the LA channel. Maintenance: new walk-in shelves arrived, installation scheduled for Sunday; new soap dispenser installed at the kitchen handwashing sink; grease trap cleaning scheduled for Saturday; third follow-up on oven cleaning planned; still and sparkling water taps reading at 65, conversation with the vendor continues; men's restroom door needs repainting. No incidents; no-shows charged. Highlight: a table celebrating the completion of an engineering certification on a bar crawl.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 11/19 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 1:16am ET 11/20)** Net $3,494.46 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $5,228 (66.8%). Marquee bar / total sales $3,849.44; Garden $0; food $281.85; no event sales reported. Discounts $68.77 (2.0%; community member/investor 10% $9.72, DNL $46.00, friends & family 15% $13.05). 95 guests (77 walk-ins, 18 reservations); check avg $36.78 (net/guests; form $34.94). Not many reservations, but foot traffic picked up the slack. A few 2-tops at 5pm gave a nice little pop that carried until things calmed down around 7pm; with the slower pace, the second server's in-time was pushed back to 8pm. Two team members got a head start on cleaning for Season's Greetings before heading out around 9:45pm; the bar team rocked a steady bar top all night and one server closed the floor solo. Solid and steady all round. Kitchen: very light night, with donuts and bread and butter the top performers; kitchen close checked. Went well: great energy, communication. Do better: linen napkins hide in the seats and around table bases — keep an eye out. No incidents; no-shows not charged; $0 no-show/cancellation revenue. Maintenance: curtain. Highlight: a special guest appearance from two friends of the house.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 11/19 (AM Sam & Marcus; PM James & Drew; entered by Alexis; posted 1:59am ET 11/20)** Net $5,678 vs target $6,414 (88.5%). Morning bar $473, evening bar $4,079; Hot Eye $1,125; Sun Club $0 (closed); no events; food $1,780; comps $89 (1.6%). 118 guests (18 AM + 100 PM OpenTable); check avg $48.12 (net/guests). Morning: not much to report — low hotel occupancy kept breakfast slow with very little lunch business; only one food tour, with 6 guests. Evening: very smooth and chill, except for a surprise 17-top that came in to celebrate a birthday; two servers divided and conquered the table and the party had a good time, got food and drink quickly and left without any stress. Otherwise a run-of-the-mill evening: the restaurant saw almost one complete turn and the bar never got overwhelmingly packed. Hot Eye: on the chill side — a very quiet first couple of hours, then a steady evening of industry and some hotel guests; lots of meaningful guest connections, and the team set time aside to finish the holiday cocktail menu. Kitchen: slow night; a cook was cut at 7pm (too slow for three on the line); no complaints or send-backs, no lows or 86s. No incidents. Highlight: guests stopping in to ask when the DJ starts Friday night and saying they would bring some new faces.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: Cold but sunny; minimal impact on walk-in velocity
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thursday 11/19 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 4:29am ET 11/20)** Net $10,557 vs target $10,259 (102.9%). Food $1,724; no events; comps $287.42 (2.7%; higher DNLs and a service recovery from a Resy mistake; first round comped per a request from ownership by email). 234 guests; check avg $45.12. A brisk and sunny Thursday with a Sounders playoff match (they were knocked out). Great start with a significant push from the pre-gamers; rocking until the match started at 7pm, then a brief lull until about 9:15pm when it ended, and still a decent push to land a solid $10.5k for the night. Solid energy throughout with the floor buzzing all night. Door made some strong back-flips happen with tables; the bar rocked out heavy and the four-person weave seems to be working very well. Kitchen held it down, doing $1.7k with a late push on food. No events, no maintenance needs, no 86s or lows. No incidents; no-shows charged. Highlight: meeting two guests, one of whom had lived in Kansas City, and talking about living there and in LA.
